'''Manfred Meinsen''' (17 July 1938 – 1 February 2025) was a German politician. A member of [[Alliance 90/The Greens|The Greens]], he served in the [[Landtag of Lower Saxony]] from 1982 to 1986.<ref>{{cite book |last=Simon|first=Barbara|date=1996|title=Abgeordnete in Niedersachsen 1946–1994. Biographisches Handbuch|url= |trans-title= |language=German|location=Hanover|publisher=Landtag of Lower Saxony|page=249–250|isbn=|access-date=}}</ref>

Meinsen died in [[Oldenburg (city)|Oldenburg]] on 1 February 2025, at the age of 86.<ref>{{cite news |last=Bickschlag|first=Carsten|date=9 February 2025|title=Pionier der Grünen und Umweltschützer im Alter von 86 Jahren verstorben|url=https://www.nwzonline.de/cloppenburg-kreis/trauer-um-manfred-meinsen-aus-altenoythe-pionier-der-gruenen-und-umweltschuetzer-im-alter-von-86-jahren-verstorben_a_4,1,3969712941.html#|trans-title= |work=Nordwest-Zeitung|language=German|location= |publisher= |access-date=18 February 2025}}</ref>
